question: 'MPSV' is related to 'ORUX' in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, 'CFIL' is related to 'EHKN'. To which of the following is 'ORUX' related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'MPSV' is related to 'ORUX'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/581695c0decb6419c5ce944b3e8c68d3eb761ab320445c17e098471f2a59ae8d.png] 

For, 'CFIL' is related to 'EHKN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbe41ee7f20564bfa4c9c1c31883eb9978f347563f62359bc2d823191b9eacc6.png] 

Similarly, for '**ORUX**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1f1d6dfcd98c5fb437c2403c55e768fa83977210b0408af5d90d093c98a0680.png] 

So, 'ORUX' will be related to '**QTWZ**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
